title: The Goat Who Got Out
cast: Bo is a young goat with a soft cream-white coat, two small pale horns, floppy white ears, a short tail, and a bright red collar around his neck. The farm around him has a big red barn, a wooden fence, green grass, a blue duck pond, and a field of yellow flowers.
keep: Bo is a young goat with a soft cream-white coat, two small pale horns, floppy white ears, a short tail, and a bright red collar with a small gold heart charm.

p1.text: Bo pushed on his gate. It swung open wide. The whole farm was waiting!
p1.art: Bo the goat pushing his wooden gate open with his nose and stepping out into the sunny farmyard, looking excited. The big red barn stands behind him.

a.text: A duck sat by the pond. She had a row of ducklings. They all quacked at Bo.
a.art: Bo the goat meeting a white duck and her fluffy yellow ducklings at the edge of the blue pond.

b.text: The barn smelled like warm hay. A tiny kitten blinked at him. Then it climbed the hay.
b.art: Bo the goat inside the barn among golden hay bales, meeting a small orange kitten that is climbing a hay bale.

c.text: The field was full of flowers. A fat bee buzzed past. Bo sneezed a big sneeze.
c.art: Bo the goat standing in the field of yellow flowers with a fat bumblebee buzzing past his nose, mid-sneeze.

a2.text: The ducklings swam in a line. Bo dipped in one hoof. The water was very cold!
a2.art: Bo the goat dipping one hoof into the pond while the little yellow ducklings swim past in a neat line.

b2.text: The kitten came to say hi. It sat down in the hay. Bo held very still.
b2.art: Inside a barn full of golden hay: one white goat standing still, and beside him one small ginger tabby CAT — a fluffy orange kitten with pointed cat ears, long whiskers and a long striped tail — sitting in the hay looking up at him. Exactly one goat and one cat.

c2.text: Bo followed the buzzy bee. It landed on a red flower. More bees came to look.
c2.art: Bo the goat following a bumblebee that has landed on a single red flower among the yellow flowers.

a2x.text: Bo jumped in with a splash. The ducklings splashed him back. Everyone got very wet.
a2x.art: Bo the goat splashing in the shallow edge of the pond with the ducklings splashing water back at him, droplets flying, all delighted.

a2y.text: They looked down in the water. One little fish swam by. It waved its tail hello.
a2y.art: Bo the goat and the ducklings peering down into the clear pond water at one small orange fish waving its tail.

a2z.text: The duck showed Bo her nest. It was soft and warm. One egg wiggled a little!
a2z.art: The white duck showing Bo the goat her cozy straw nest beside the pond, with one speckled egg wiggling in it.

b2x.text: They walked all around the barn. The kitten stayed right beside him. It purred the whole time.
b2x.art: Bo the goat and the small ginger tabby kitten walking side by side along the path around the outside of the barn, both looking very pleased.

b2y.text: They jumped in the soft hay. Hay flew up in the air. Bo had hay on his nose.
b2y.art: Bo the goat and the orange kitten jumping into a big pile of loose golden hay, hay flying up around them, a wisp of hay on Bo's nose.

b2z.text: Bo found the milk bowl. The kitten drank it all up. Bo chewed a carrot instead.
b2z.art: The orange kitten drinking from a milk bowl on the barn floor while Bo the goat chews an orange carrot beside it.

c2x.text: Bo picked one yellow flower. He held it in his teeth. It tickled his nose.
c2x.art: Bo the goat holding a single yellow flower in his teeth, the petals tickling his nose, standing in the flower field.

c2y.text: The bee flew to its hive. Bo watched from far away. The hive hummed a song.
c2y.art: Bo the goat watching from a safe distance as the bumblebee returns to a round hive hanging in a tree at the edge of the sunny field.

c2z.text: A blue butterfly floated by. Bo chased it through the grass. It danced right past his nose.
c2z.art: Bo the goat standing alone in tall green grass, watching a single bright blue butterfly flutter just in front of his nose. Only one goat in the picture.
